title: Numerical range and Berezin range of weighted composition operators on weighted Dirichlet spaces
summary: We investigate the numerical ranges of weighted composition operators on weighted Dirichlet spaces, focusing on the properties of the inducing functions. We identify conditions on these functions under which the origin lies in the interior of the numerical range. The geometric structure of the numerical range is also analyzed, determining when it contains a circular or elliptical disc and computing the corresponding radius.
